DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair), cel-shaded skin and silk with soft airbrushed gradients and crisp drawn fold lines. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly old-master faces, NOT 3D. ONLY THESE TWO PEOPLE in the frame. ENEMY GENERALS WHO RESPECT EACH OTHER. They face each other in profile across the frame, faces a stride apart, locked in a long stare of total respect. Yushin, old, grey full beard, in grey steel lamellar armour and a tall pointed Silla helm. Gyebek, younger, CLEAN-SHAVEN, black topknot, grey steel lamellar with ochre-gold cloth and a crimson scarf. Swords sheathed at their hips. A blue key from the left on Yushin, a gold key from the right on Gyebek, a black seam of smoke between them. Any sword is the ancient straight Korean ring-pommel dao: a small iron ring pommel, a short wrapped grip, a thin metal band and NO hand guard, a perfectly straight blade — never a katana, never a tsuba. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): LEFT of the sheet = KIM YUSHIN; RIGHT of the sheet = GYEBEK. KIM YUSHIN — Look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows, deep-set eyes. Dress: Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash knotted at the waist, white inner collar, dark wrapped forearms. Off duty: plain blue po, no jewelry. Now: Marshal: full black beard and moustache; a blue ribbon in the topknot instead of the headband. Colour #2A5FB8. | GYEBEK — Look: Lean and hard, sun-dark skin; black hair in a high topknot with loose strands over the brow; heavy scowl, narrow dark eyes, clean-shaven. Dress: Ochre-gold jeogori and trousers, a crimson scarf knotted at the chest, crimson sash at the waist, forearms wrapped in dark cloth. Colour #d9b13a. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (dark manhwa tenebrism, like a dramatic manhwa splash page): a near-BLACK background of drifting smoke and haze faintly tinted with the characters' colours, no detailed set — at most one dim prop or architectural edge; ONE hard directional key light from the side or below carves the faces and silk in high contrast, the far side of each figure falling off into black shadow, a thin edge of the same light along the silhouettes; deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, strong cast shadows across the faces. Each person's colour is the colour of the light and the shadow-tint on them and in the smoke behind them — never a glow aura or halo.
